properties.description: a_scoped_loop_status_fits_its_budget.rs::an_unscoped_loop_status_withholds_breach_rows_before_prose_and_counts_them: 25 long-named defect findings and nothing awaiting; loop_status at budget_chars 6,000 must fit, keep breaches_open at 25, name `breaches` in budget.lists_shortened with shown equal to the rows kept and total equal to the rows listed, and keep the to-do line in `next` that counts the open breaches. The reply_budget unit test pins the list-first order with `next` kept whole.
properties.findings: On main 02e2739c8 it FAILS: 7,100 characters to a 6,000 budget, prose cut and every breach row kept. With the fix it passes with the file's other three tests. Measured on main's design copy with the fixed debug build: budget 10,000 answers 9,754; 6,000 answers 5,249; 3,000 answers 5,449, the reply's floor (every count, one row per list, all prose cut), which the reply says (2026-10-26).
properties.name: An unscoped loop_status holds its budget, breaches included
